tei:div.tei:p: gtor ma 'di longs rang rang gnas su dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hrī: phyi snod rdo rje me phung 'bar ba'i gur: nang bcud dbang chen khro bo'i phyag rgya'i lhar: yongs shar ye shes mchog gis byin brlabs pas: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgegs tshogs mtshams bcad gyur: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na dz+wa la rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drug pa ye shes byin 'beb ni: hrī: gzhi dbyings rdo rje btsun mo'i pho brang nas: gzhi snang dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lhas: zung 'jug sgyu ma'i rol par byin phobs la: sgo gsum 'chi med gnyug ma'i dbang mchog skur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dā raḥs pa ri wā ra dz+nyā na badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā: e a ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdun pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni: hrī: yul dang dbang po 'brel ba'i rtog tshogs kun: 'od gsal dbu ma'i dbyings su dag byas pas: byang chub sems kyi bkod pa'i mchod sprin che: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'khor lor shar: oṃ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she dharma dhā tu ma hā a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya: dngos gzhir mngon byang rnam pa lngas: dam tshig dkyil 'khor skyed pa ni: hrī: 'khor 'das yongs khyab rang rig de bzhin nyid: 'gag med snying rjer kun tu snang ba'i rtsal: rgyu yi ting 'dzin nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: kha ṭ+wāṃ hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: srid dang zhi ba'i tshe bcud mtha' dag bkug: tshur 'dus snyoms 'jug bde stong ngo bor zhu: de las phyi snod rdo rje btsun mo'i dbyings: rnam thar gsum ldan chos kyi 'byung gnas dbus: bdag nyid 'chi med ḍā ki man+dā ra: dmar gsal khro chags sgeg pa'i gzi byin 'bar: phyag g.yas skye shi rtsad gcod gri gug dang: g.yon pas dngos grub mchog stsol thod bum bsnams:

mchan khung sku gsum yongs rdzogs kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: thabs mchog bde chen yab kyi tshul du 'khril: gcer bu dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: spyan gsum 'od gsal snang bzhi'i dbyings su gzigs: zhabs gnyis pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i steng: bskyang bskum gar gyis bam ro'i snying gar brdzis: ral pa'i skra gseb rig bdag thod phreng rtsal: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnams: de ltar gsal ba'i rang byung lus kyi dkyil: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan grong khyer dbus: yi dam yongs 'dus dbang chen rigs mchog lnga: rdo rje phag mo yum dang gnyis med sbyor: de las gyes pa'i nyer bzhi'i rtsa 'dab tu: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs: gzhan yang rab 'byams rtsa gsum chos srung lha: dpag med nam mkha' khyab par gsal ba yi: gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lngas: rgyas btab rgyal kun sku gsung thugs rdo rje: yon tan phrin las ngo bor dbang bskur cing: snyoms 'jug sgra yis ye shes spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hrī: ka dag dbyings snang chos sku'i 'og min dang: lhun grub 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing: zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsum 'chi med ḍā ki'i lha tshogs rnams: gang 'dul thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum du byin phob la: lus ngag yid la dga' bzhi'i dbang mchog skur: 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dā raḥs pa ri wā ra e a ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī: don dam 'chi med rtag pa'i ye shes sku: gshegs byon bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang: kun rdzob dam tshig sems dpa'i grong khyer du: ye shes lha tshogs gnyis med dgyes par bzhugs: dz+nyā na badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

bzhi pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: bde ba'i bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng gi: shes rab stong pa'i yum gcig man+dā ra: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: gnyis med gus pa'i brda yis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: snang srid gzhir bzhengs stong gsal phyag rgya'i gzugs: srog rtsol dbu mar thim pa'i rdo rje'i sgra: 'bar 'dzag bde bas khyab pa'i lhan skyes dri: yas babs mas brtan dga' bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i ro: gtum mo'i 'od las skyed pa'i reg bya dang: rnam thar gsum ldan rdo rje chos kyi dbyings: rlung sems dwangs ma 'ching ba'i a mṛ ta: gzung 'dzin 'khor ba dbyings sgrol dmar chen po: ye shes lnga ldan 'dod yon ba liṃ ta: bde stong zung 'jug sbyor sgrol 'od gsal klong: yul dang dbang po mnyam sbyor mchod pa'i sprin: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med rtag pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dā raḥs pa ri wā ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she dharma dhā tu ma hā a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta sarba pū dzaḥho: drug pa rdo rje'i glu yis bstod: hrī: gzod nas spros bral shes rab pha rol phyin: rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i gzugs: gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol can: 'chi med man+dā raḥb khyod la 'dud: bcu drug dga' ba'i rang bzhin mtshan dpe'i sku: e waṃ zung 'jug rdo rje nā da'i gsung: bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes mchog gi thugs: gnas gsum ḍā ki'i tshogs rje khyod la bstod: bkod pa rtsa khams 'ja' lus dwangs mar shar: 'gro 'ong rlung kun dbu ma'i dbyings su thim: zag bcas thig le 'pho med bde stong klong: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang 'grub gyur cig: gang shar snang cha lha skur gsal: dag pa dran dang nga rgyal brtan: mthar thug gnyug ma'i rgya yis gdab:

bdun pa dzap kyi dgongs pa ni: de las ngal gso bya ba dang: mchog thun dngos grub myur 'grub slad: bzlas pa gsung gi rnal 'byor la: rlung sems dbyer med ngang nas 'jug: bdag nyid 'chi med ḍā ki nī'i: thugs kar longs sku tshe dpag med: gos dkar yum dang mnyam par sbyor: snying dbus 'od gsal dbu ma'i sbubs: thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dā raḥsarba sid+dhi hūm̐: de las byung ba'i yi ge'i sprin: ye shes sems dpa' yab yum gyi: 'khor lo rnam bzhir zhugs pa las: bde stong dga' bzhi'i dbang mchog thob: 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod: byin rlabs dngos grub rang la thim: slar 'phros 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyang: snod bcud lha sngags chos nyid ngang: ma yengs dgongs pa'i 'dzin phur gdab: de nas las la sbyor ba ni: slar yang kha sbyor 'khor lo'i klong: dbang chen rigs lnga yab yum gyi: thugs las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: 'khor 'das tshe bcud 'byung ba dang: ye shes lnga yi dwangs ma kun: 'ja' zer thig le'i rnam par bkug: so so'i gsang gsum la thim pas: bde stong ye shes nyams 'bar nas: 'bar 'dzag snyoms 'jug bdud rtsi'i sprin: rtsa rlung thig le'i dpyid du 'dres: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dā raḥm hā puṇ+ye ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi tshe bh+rūm̐ nri dza: 'jug gnas ldang ba'i srog rtsol rlung: yi ge gcig tu rnam par dag: kha sbyor bde chen rdo rje'i ngang: 'chi med gnyug ma'i rang zhal blta: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: de ltar bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi: zab mo'i bzlas pa la goms pas: 1$0000250snang ba lha yi 'khor lor shar: grags pa sngags kyi rang sgrar dag: rtog tshog gang shar rang grol ngang: mthar thug don gyi btsan sa zin: gnas skabs ye shes mkha' 'gro yis:

dngos nyams rmi lam ma nges par: zhal mthong byin rlabs dbang bskur thob: bhan+dha 'phar dang bdud rtsi 'phel: 'du ba gsum gyi dngos grub dang: 'bar ba gsum gyi drod rtags 'byung: phrin las rnam bzhi gang brtsam 'grub: khyad par 'chi med go 'phang thob: tho rangs brgya rtsa ma chag kyang: dus min 'chi ba nges par 'joms: thun mtshams sku gsum tshe yi lha: thugs dam bskul zhing tshe bcud sdus: skye med ka dag 'od gsal klong: 'pho med dgongs pa'i rgya yis gdab: 1$0000300sa ma ya: brgyad pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: lus gnad rdo rje'i chos bdun bca': 'byung ba'i rlung dug bsal nas kyang: phyi nang gsang ba'i stong ra bsgom: kha sbyor bzhi ldan gsal stong ngang: lte 'og sbas pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa līs: spyi bo'i thig le bzhu ba yis: 'khor lo lnga yi dkyil 'khor mchod: bde stong zung 'jug don la blta: bogs 'don las kyi phyag rgya mar: snyoms 'jug zag med ngang la bzhag: rjes thob dag dang ma dag gi: snang ba thams cad sgyu mar sbyang: nyal khar snod bcud 'od gsal ngang: rig pa ye shes sbubs su 'jug: rmi lam gang shar ngos bzung la: sbyang spel sprul sgyur rang ngor bzhag: thams cad rig stong zung 'jug dbyings: brjod bral phyag rgya chen po'i gshis: bca' bcos spang blang bral ba yis: ye shes lha tshogs rang la shar: don dam 'chi med ḍā ki 'grub: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: rjes la tshogs kyi rim pa ni: dam tshig nyams chag kun sbyang zhing: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs slad: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes byed pa'i: thabs dang shes rab dam tshig rdzas: bla med mchod pas mdun bdar te: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: snang srid rnam dag ye shes ka pā lar: 'chi med bde ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas: tshogs drug rang grol 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin: mi zad kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni:

hrī: 'og min chos dbyings spros bral pho brang dang: kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan long sku'i zhing: sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas yul dur khrod nas: mkha' spyod ḍā ki'i gtso mo man+dā ra: 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: bde stong tshogs kyi 'du bar spyan 'dren na: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis gshegs nas kyang: snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum du byin phobs la: 'gyur med bde chen rdo rje'i dbang mchog skur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dā raḥsarba dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gsum pa tshogs phud rim gsum gyi: dang po mchod pa'i sprin du spro: hrī: ngo bo 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi la: rnam pa rdo rje gzugs sgra dri ro reg: mtha' klas nam mkha' dang mnyam mchod sprin che: 'bul lo bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she dharma dhā tu sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar pa dam tshig nyams chag bshags: hrī: gdod nas chos dbyings snying por ro gcig kyang: gnyis 'dzin glo bur 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang gis: sdom dang dam tshig 'gal pa'i tshogs rnams kun: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod: tha ma sbyor sgrol mchod pas bskang: hrī: kun 'byung 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i dgra dang bgegs: skye med rdo rje'i mtshon gyis bsgral nas kyang: phung khams skye mched rigs lnga'i longs spyod mchog: yongs grub dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du sbyor: sarba sha trun dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: mā ra ya rbad: ma hā pañca a mṛta ta na gha na pū dza ho: bzhi pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i mu ran skyong ba yi: ma mo ḍā ki zhing skyong lhag sdud tshogs: tha tshig gnyan po'i gtor ma 'di longs la: tshe dpal longs spyod 'du ba rgyas par mdzod: ma ma ḍā ki nī giṅka ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi:

lnga pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hrī: 'od gsal thig le chen po'i gzhi dbyings las: zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pa: 'chi med grub pa'i me tog man+dā ra: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i thugs dam bskul: hrī: ka dag nang gsal gnyug ma'i pho brang nas: phrin las yongs kyi spyi dpal kun bzang mo: rig stong zung 'jug chos sku'i klong nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das zad sar skyol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hrī: lhun grub 'ja' zer thig le'i pho brang nas: rnam kun mchog ldan lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma: bde stong zung 'jug long sku'i klong nas bzhengs: rang lus 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hrī: gnas yul lnga bcu rtsa drug pho brang nas: zhing skyes ḍā ki'i gtso mo man+dā ra: snang stong zung 'jug sprul sku'i klong nas bzhengs: 'chi med dngos grub brnyes pa'i phrin las mdzod: hrī: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pho brang nas: sngags skyes dpa' bo ḍā ki'i dkyil 'khor lha: dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku'i klong nas bzhengs: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dbyings su sbyor: rlung sems 'pho med dbu ma'i klong du sgrol: rtog tshogs rang grol gdod ma'i phyag rgyar zlogs: skye 'chi bya rtsol bral ba'i phrin las mdzod: drug pa chad tho bsgrag pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i gzhal yas khang: bkra shis brag phug mā ra ti ka ru: bde ba chen po pad+ma thod phreng gis: stong nyid shes rab man+dā raḥbar 'khril: lhan skyes nye rgyu'i 'chi med dngos grub brnyes: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ma'i tshogs: ye shes phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la bcug ste: 'bar 'dzag rgyan gyi mchod gtor byin pa'i tshe: phung khams dwangs mar thim par ma chad dam: 'chi bdag bdud dpung gzhom par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam:

tha tshig gnyan po'i gtor ma 'di longs la: khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du phrin mdzod: bdun pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'chi med pad+ma thod phreng yab yum gyis: dam la bzhag pa'i bod skyong brtan ma'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs bshal chu'i bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: gangs can bstan 'gro bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma ḍā ki nī hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta kha hi: brgyad pa mnan pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sku gsum 'chi med ḍā ki'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dbang chen khros pa'i rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i dam sri 'byung po kun: rnam thar gsum ldan chos kyi dbyings su thim: oṃ āḥhūm̐ s+t+wam+bha ya nan: dgu pa mchod bstod dngos grub blang: hūm̐ hrī: dbyings rig zung 'jug sku gsum pho brang nas: bde stong 'chi med ḍā ki'i lha tshogs rnams: bsnyen sgrub rdo rje'i dam tshig thems lags na: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: gnas skabs srid dang zhi ba'i tshe bcud kun: bsdus la rnal 'byor 'chi med 'grub pa dang: mthar thug sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: ā yur+dz+nyā na kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dha pha la ho: bcu pa nongs pa bshags pa ni: ho: gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i gshis lugs la: glo bur 'khrul pa'i bshags bya ma mchis kyang: kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i snang cha ru: nongs pa gang mchis snying nas bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod: bcu gcig rtag chad bsal ba ni: hrī: bde chen sgyu ma'i snang char shar ba'i lha: 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su thim: slar yang snang grags rig pa'i chos rnams kun: lha sngags chos sku'i ye shes gcig tu shar: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: bcu gnyis bsngo smon mtshams sbyor ni: ho: ka dag bsam brjod bral ba'i dkyil 'khor du: lhun grub bsags dang gsag bya'i dge tshogs kun:

chos dbyings gzhon nu bum skur bsngo bar bya: kun kyang rnam kun mchog ldan thob par shog: bcu gsum shis pa brjod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang: dngos grub char 'beb yi dam zhi dang khro: phrin las lhun grub mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi bkra shis shog: gdod nas spros bral 'od gsal chos sku'i klong: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnam rol las: gang 'dul sprul pa'i rang gzugs man+dā ra: sku gsum 'chi med ḍā ki'i bkra shis shog: thun mong phrin las ma lus lhun gyis grub: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor shar: bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal chos sku'i klong: mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod me tog char du bsnyil: sa ma ya: de ltar ye shes ḍā ki nī: 'chi med man+dā raḥb yi: srog gi gdams pa'i lhag ma 'di: 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis: byin gyi brlabs pa'i rig pa 'dzin: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje yi: chos dbyings gsang ba'i sgrom bu ru: klong gsal mkha' 'gro brda ru sbas: nam zhig rten 'brel dus babs tshe: 'gro don rgya cher 'byung bar shog: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim:

1$0000250'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog sgrub las: tshe 'gugs 'chi med mchog sbyin bzhugs: 1$0000300hrī: ngo bo 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang nas: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang tshe yi lha: thugs dam bskul lo snang bzhi'i tshe bcud sdus: 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: rang bzhin bde stong longs sku'i pho brang nas: 'od snang mtha' yas 'chi med tshe yi lha: thugs dam bskul lo dga' bzhi'i tshe bcud sdus: kha sbyor bde chen rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: thugs rje 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas: pad+ma sam bha 'chi med tshe yi lha: thugs dam bskul lo srid zhi'i tshe bcud sdus: dwangs ma mi shigs rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: 'og min pad+ma drwa ba'i pho brang nas: man+dā raḥb 'chi med tshe yi lha: thugs dam bskul lo brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud sdus: phung khams mi shigs rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrub pa'i pho brang nas: ye shes ḍā ki 'chi med tshe yi lha: thugs dam bskul lo 'byung bzhi'i tshe bcud sdus: rtsa khams 'pho med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rgya mtshor bcas: 'gro la 'chi med stsol ba'i thugs dam can: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dus 'dir dgyes dgongs la: 'khor 'das snang srid brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud sdus: rnal 'byor bdag gi rtsa rlung thig le dang: dbyer med dam tshig sgrub pa'i rdzas la stims: bla tshe chad nyams yar pa rang sor chud: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma man+dā raḥm hā puṇ+ye ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi tshe bh+rūm̐ nri dza: a: spros pas 'khor 'das kun khyab rdo rje'i tshe: bsdus pas 'chi med thig le nyag cig klong:
